questions.q_en: What is the difference between the number of milk packets of company M and N sold by shopkeeper A and B together and the number of milk packets of company N and O sold by shopkeeper C and E together?
questions.solution_en:
The number of milk packets of company M and N sold by shopkeeper A and B together = 240 + 280 + 320 + 440 = 1280

The number of milk packets of company N and O sold by shopkeeper C and E together = 260 + 480 + 420 + 280 = 1440

So, required difference = 1440 - 1280 = 160

questions.q_en: If population of State B in 2002 was 20 lakhs, what will be the average population of the state in 2003 and 2004?
questions.solution_en:
Population State B in 2003 = 20x1.4 = 28 lakhs

Population State B in 2004 = 28x1.45 = 40.6 lakhs

Average population = (28+40.6)/2 = 34.3 lakhs
